summary: Forcepoint email gateway in the cloud, hybrid or on-prem: stops phishing, spam, spoofed senders and malicious attachments in inbound email and checks outbound email for data leaks.
value: Phishing emails, “CEO” impersonation and malicious attachments are stopped at the gateway before reaching employee mailboxes.
Outbound emails with sensitive data are stopped or held by the DLP policy already included in the product.
Protection complements the built-in capabilities of Microsoft Exchange / Microsoft 365.
simple: Forcepoint Email Security inspects inbound, outbound and internal email: phishing and business email compromise (BEC) detection, sender spoofing protection, link and attachment analysis, content filters, enforced TLS. Deployed on-prem (appliance or VMware virtual machine), in Microsoft Azure, hybrid with cloud pre-filtering or as a cloud service; integrates natively with Microsoft Exchange. DLP for the email channel is included in the product without a separate DLP license, agent or Protector; policies are in Forcepoint Security Manager. Licensed per mailbox (user).
notIncluded: Attachment sandbox (Advanced Malware Detection for Email — Cloud / On-Premises) is an add-on.
URL sandbox, phishing education and cloud pre-filtering are in the Hybrid Module (add-on).
Advanced email encryption is the Encryption Module (add-on).
The built-in DLP does not have all options of full Forcepoint DLP — the full set is in Forcepoint DLP / DLP for Email.
DLP beyond email (web, endpoints) — that is Forcepoint DLP.
classification: Inbound email protection against phishing, BEC and malicious attachments — email security.
Built-in DLP for the email channel — DLP (like FortiMail Base).
Sandbox is an add-on according to the documentation, not counted as a class; “phishing education” in the Hybrid Module is not security awareness training, text only.
